# Repository instructions

The source of truth for this repository is in `platform/specs/`. Read these before changing anything:

- `platform/specs/architecture.md`: the application structure, executables and key components, including "Validating Changes End to End" and "Documentation Synchronization".
- `platform/specs/rules.md`: the rules for all code under `src/`.
- `platform/specs/systems.md`: the systems and the source paths that belong to each.
- `platform/specs/docs-site/rules.md` and `platform/specs/docs-site/list-pages.md`: the rules for the documentation pages under `docs/content/docs/`.
